invariants.statement: Images exhibit a top-down aerial perspective with a granular, high-frequency texture representing ground surfaces.
invariants.evidence: All 8 reference images are satellite/aerial views showing detailed ground textures (vegetation, soil, pavement) rather than smooth or abstract patterns.

invariants.statement: The color palette is dominated by natural earth tones (browns, greens, greys) with no artificial neon or saturated hues.
invariants.evidence: Every image displays realistic remote sensing colors: green vegetation, brown soil, and grey infrastructure, consistent with natural lighting.

invariants.statement: Structures and terrain features display continuous, coherent boundaries without abrupt, unnatural geometric truncations.
invariants.evidence: In all 8 images, roads, fields, and buildings have complete, logical shapes; there are no missing chunks or floating artifacts.
